title: King Jehoiakim Burns the Scroll
description: King Jehoiakim sits in his winter house during the ninth month while Jehudi reads aloud the scroll from the prophet Jeremiah. For every third or fourth column, the king cuts off a piece of the scroll with a scribe's knife and throws it into the fire, until the entire scroll is burned up. Neither the king nor his servants are seized with fear. Elnatan, Delaiah, and Gemariah beg him not to burn the scroll, but he will not listen. The king then orders Jerahmeel, Seraiah, and Shelemiah to seize Baruch and Jeremiah, but the Lord hides them.
